description.simpleText:
Heathrow Airport Live ( LHR )
#heathrowairportlive  #heathrowairport #heathrowplanespotting #avgeek #livestream #planespotting 
Live at London Heathrow Airport.

Instagram @flightfocus365 

Ai based Robocam with a dedicated human team tirelessly working and streaming 365 days a year from dawn till dusk. Our aim is to have these installed at multiple airports worldwide, starting with major UK airports, offering 4k quality streaming for everyone. Only with your help and support via membership will this become possible.

Flight Focus 365 Team

© 2025 FlightFocus365. All rights reserved.

Chat Rules

- Keep it family friendly
- Keep it positive, avoid talking about aviation incidents
- No spam, this includes emoji and non-standard fonts, and no all caps
- Avoid asking other users for personally identifying information
- Do not score landings
- NO politics or Religion comments 
- If a user is providing call-outs, please wait until they have finished before sharing your own
- Try to keep it on topic - some casual conversation is allowed, however this is first and foremost a chat for aviation and Heathrow Airport
- Refrain from discussing the content of other Heathrow streams
- Please translate all chat into English if not native language
- The mods reserve the right to step in and remove messages and users that negatively impact the chat for other users.

#planespottingheathrow #heathrowairportlive #liveplanespotting #heathrow #london
